title: Git Push in 5 Steps!

steps.title: Step 1: Initialize Git
steps.explanation: Start by initializing a new Git repository in your project folder.

steps.title: Step 2: Add Files
steps.explanation: Add all your project files to the staging area.

steps.title: Step 3: Commit Changes
steps.explanation: Commit your changes with a descriptive message.

steps.title: Step 4: Link to GitHub
steps.explanation: Connect your local repo to your GitHub repository.

steps.title: Step 5: Push to GitHub
steps.explanation: Push your code to the main branch on GitHub. Try it yourself!
